name: second-brain-connector
description: A small remote MCP server that lets Claude read and write a markdown vault stored in a private GitHub repo.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with Contents: read and write on your vault repo only.

GITHUB_REPO.description: Your private vault repo as owner/name, e.g. jane/my-vault.

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: A passphrase of 12+ characters. You type it once when Claude connects.
